faqData.a: MIAR AI/FOOD is a complete food service ecosystem connecting POS, tables, commandas, QR digital menu, kitchen KDS, inventory, delivery, and artificial intelligence on a single unified platform.

faqData.q: What types of establishments is MIAR AI/FOOD designed for?
faqData.a: The system is tailored for restaurants, bars, cafes, pizzerias, dark kitchens, bakeries, food trucks, and food service operations of any scale.

faqData.q: What modules are included in the ecosystem?
faqData.a: MIAR AI/FOOD includes Front-of-House POS, Table & Waiter App, QR Digital Menu, Kitchen Display (KDS), Stock & Recipe Control, Delivery Management, Financial Tracking, and AI Sales Analytics.
Yes, our local POS resilience allows cashiers and waiters to continue taking orders even if internet connectivity drops temporarily.

faqData.q: How can I start using MIAR AI/FOOD?
faqData.a: Contact our team to request a demo and choose the ideal plan for your establishment.
